specification:
Prudentia YouTube video-on-demand workload with player telemetry (SIGCOMM '24, Table 1).
1. Go to 'https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=<secret>video_id</secret>&autoplay=1' (reference video: Big Buck Bunny).
2. Wait briefly for the player page to load and autoplay to start.
3. Poll the YouTube player's Stats-for-nerds telemetry <secret>samples</secret> times at <secret>interval_seconds</secret> second intervals; the polling doubles as the watch timer.
